chunks: Then proceed to Arafat and say, as you are heading toward it: “O Allah, to You I have turned, upon You I have relied, Your Face I have sought, Your word I have affirmed as true, and Your command I have followed. I ask You to bless my lifespan for me, fulfill my need for me, and make me among those by whom You boast today before one who is better than me.” Then recite the talbiyah while you are going to Arafat, and do not depart from Mina before the rising of dawn in any way.

When you come to Arafat, set up your tent at Namirah near the mosque, for there the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله set up his tent and his dome. Then when the sun declines on the Day of Arafah, stop the talbiyah, perform ghusl, and pray the zuhr and the 'asr with one adhan and two iqamahs. You only hasten the prayer and combine the two so that you may devote yourself to supplication, for it is a day of supplication and asking.

Then come to the standing place with tranquility and dignity. Stand at the foot of the mountain on its left side, supplicate with the supplication of the standing, and pray much for your parents, asking your Lord, Mighty and Majestic, to grant them to you. Do not stand except while you are in a state of taharah and have performed ghusl, and do not depart from it until the sun sets; for if you depart before its setting, the blood-sacrifice of a sheep becomes binding upon you.

key_terms.تُلَبِّ: Recite the talbiyah while proceeding in the rites of hajj.
key_terms.دَمُ شَاةٍ: The sacrificial penalty of a sheep for leaving before sunset.
key_terms.دُعَاءِ: Supplication, especially on the Day of Arafah.
key_terms.عَرَفَاتٍ: Arafat, the sacred site of the major standing during hajj.
key_terms.ٱغْتَسِلْ: Perform ghusl, the ritual bath before the standing and prayer.
key_terms.ٱلتَّلْبِيَةَ: The pilgrim's ritual invocation recited during hajj.
key_terms.ٱلْمَوْقِفَ: The standing place at Arafat where the pilgrim performs wuquf.

ai.seo_question: What should a pilgrim do on the way to Arafat and during the standing at Arafat in hajj?
ai.summary: This passage outlines part of the rites of hajj related to proceeding from Mina to Arafat, including a prescribed du'a, the continuation and cessation of talbiyah, and the timing of departure and prayer. It also gives legal and devotional guidance for the wuquf at Arafat, emphasizing taharah, supplication, prayer for one's parents, following the sunnah of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, and remaining until sunset.
